The '''Alliance Civil Government''' was the governmental command council of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==History==
The Alliance Civil Government was established after the founding of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]<ref name="RASB2" /> around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" />

==Organization==
The Alliance Civil Government functioned as the political leadership and provided for the safety of its citizens, maintaining services, raising taxes, and maintaining diplomatic relations. It was one of two branches of the Rebel Alliance, the other being the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] which was responsible for prosecuting the war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RASB2" />

===The Chief of State===
{{Main|Chancellor (Rebel Alliance)}}
The Alliance Civil Government was headed by the [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]], effectalivy a elected [[Dictatorship/Legends|dictatorship]]. Throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] held the position of Chief of State. Mothma had virtually unlimited authority over the Civil Government, although checks and balances were in place to ensure she did not overstep her position. Her decisions could be overturned by the [[Advisory Council (Alliance)|Advisory Council]] with a two-thirds majority, in which case Mothma was required to step down from the position of Chief of State. The Chief of State position was up for election every two [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. Each [[Allied Command]] had a single vote and the victor was elected by a simple majority vote.<ref name="RASB2" />

===The Advisory Council===
{{Main|Advisory Council (Alliance)}}
The Advisory Council was a representative body that was comprised of members from the seven Allied Commands that had suffered most at the hands of the Empire. Membership of the Council was not sought by any Allied Command for obvious reasons. The Council's main legal authority was the approval or disapproval of the Chief of State's actions, and they had the power to oust the Chief from office if Mon Mothma overstepped her bounds. The Council also advised Mon Mothma on the courses of actions she planned to take.<ref name="RASB2" />

===The Alliance Cabinet===
{{Main|Alliance Cabinet/Legends}}
The [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Alliance Cabinet]] was the body that turned Mon Mothma's directives into action. Each Cabinet member was selected for their abilities to get things done. The [[Secretary of the Cabinet/Legends|Secretary of the Cabinet]] was responsible for organizing the meetings of the Cabinet, and chairing the sessions when the Chief of State was unavailable to do so. The Cabinet was comprised of six beings: the [[Minister of Finance (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of Finance]], who headed the [[Finance Ministry]]; the [[Minister of Education]], who oversaw the [[Ministry of Education (Alliance)|Ministry of Education]]; the [[Minister of State (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of State]], who led the [[Ministry of State (Alliance)|Ministry of State]]; the [[Minister of Industry/Legends|Minister of Industry]], responsible for the [[Ministry of Industry (Alliance)|Ministry of Industry]]; the [[Minister of Supply/Legends|Minister of Supply]], tasked with the running of the [[Ministry of Supply]], and the [[Minister of War (Alliance)/Legends|Minister of War]] who was in charge of the [[Ministry of War (Alliance)|Ministry of War]].<ref name="RASB2" />

===Allied Commands===
{{Main|Allied Command}}
The Allied Commands were the governments and [[Sector Command (Alliance)/Legends|Sector Commands]] allied to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.<ref name="RASB2" />
